about: ROUTE R2, THE CANYON TRAIL (One World phase 4.1, the owner's north routes thread, 2026-11-17): a trail from the River Road's junction (plots 0,-4 and 1,-4, in the River Road's room) north up a dry canyon behind the Hills to the foot of Mount Shasta. ONE room, 22 plots (the list's 2 to 23; 3 x 10). Its south end is the junction's seam ow_h_1_m4. ITS NORTH END IS INTERIM: the map's last trail plots (-1..0, -14) do not touch Shasta (two scenery plots lie between them and the Trailhead, -3,-15), so the door at the top (seam ow_h_0_m14) leads to the Trailhead's south side (Shasta's door ow_h_m3_m14) until mondo says how the trail should reach it. PLACES (ow-places.js, every name an idea of Claude's): the page's ranger station stands at the junction (River Road's room); the rest are the kit's picks by the ground.
